## Example 4.12 {#iv4-example-4-12 .vector-lesson .magnitude-lesson .m-three-parts}

<p>Evaluate <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}\cdot\underset{\sim}{b}"></span> when</p><div class="m-parts"><div class="m-part"><p><strong>a)</strong> <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}=2\underset{\sim}{i}+3\underset{\sim}{j},\quad \underset{\sim}{b}=4\underset{\sim}{i}+\underset{\sim}{j}"></span></p><div data-module="reveal-panel" class="m-reveal"><button class="toggle-panel" aria-pressed="false">Show working</button><div class="panel-answer" hidden><div class="m-equation"><span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}\cdot\underset{\sim}{b}=2(4)+3(1)=11"></span></div></div></div></div><div class="m-part"><p><strong>b)</strong> <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}=3\underset{\sim}{i}-\underset{\sim}{j},\quad \underset{\sim}{b}=-6\underset{\sim}{i}+2\underset{\sim}{j}"></span></p><div data-module="reveal-panel" class="m-reveal"><button class="toggle-panel" aria-pressed="false">Show working</button><div class="panel-answer" hidden><div class="m-equation"><span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}\cdot\underset{\sim}{b}=3(-6)+(-1)(2)=-20"></span></div></div></div></div><div class="m-part"><p><strong>c)</strong> <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}=\begin{bmatrix}2\\3\end{bmatrix},\quad \underset{\sim}{b}=\begin{bmatrix}-6\\4\end{bmatrix}"></span></p><div data-module="reveal-panel" class="m-reveal"><button class="toggle-panel" aria-pressed="false">Show working</button><div class="panel-answer" hidden><div class="m-equation"><span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}\cdot\underset{\sim}{b}=2(-6)+3(4)=0"></span></div></div></div></div></div>
<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet Example 4.12 · p. 33</div>

::: notes
a) 11; b) −20; c) 0. The deliberately varied results support the definition: the answer is a scalar and can have either sign or be zero. Do not add i,j to the final answers. The geometric significance of zero is developed later.
:::
